meta.requirement: Explore Wuwang Hill (10%+ exploration) to trigger this quest.

customTabs.label: TIP
customTabs.content:
You can click the '''Collapse''' button and the '''Best Route''' → '''Important Only''' button at the top to minimize it.
''Some quests will not have a Best Route choice, because the best choice is subjective or not yet found.''

You can also click the '''Endings''' button at the top to view all possible endings, and clicking an ending will show the options needed to reach that ending.

start.title: Rock Solid
start.text: ''A woman in adventurer gear is sitting on a rock with a pack open, stuffing a coil of rope back.''

You_going_somewhere_.text:
Shan: Yeah I'm heading to Guyun Stone Forest in like three hours.

Shan: It's this island out in the sea, people don't really go there, I found a boat.

What_s_out_there_.text: Shan: Giant rocks sticking out of the water. I heard there's a cube on one of them which sounds fake but whatever I wanna see it.

Can_I_come_.text:
Shan: Sure! I have a spare spot, the boat guy said one extra person is a thousand silver.

Shan: Then come back in three hours, I'm not sitting at the dock that whole time so I'll just be right here.

choices.label: I don't have it right now

I_don_t_have_it_right_now_.text: Shan: No rush, I'll be here.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Bring 1000 Silver to Shan on Wuwang Hill

continues.label: Do /rpg again and then click on Talk to Shan

Here_s_a_thousand.text:
''She stuffs the coins in a side pocket.''

Shan: Okay you're in! See you in three hours.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Come back to Shan on Wuwang Hill in 3 hours

continues.label: Wait for 3 hours, and then do /rpg and click on Talk to Shan

Not_yet.text: Shan: I'll be here, the rope is still winning.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Bring 1000 Silver to Shan on Wuwang Hill

Talk_to_Shan.text:
''She kicks the pack shut and slings it.''

Shan: Boat's here. Come on.

____Rock_Solid__Landed_at_Guyun.title: Landed at Guyun
____Rock_Solid__Landed_at_Guyun.text: Shan: Alright that's Guyun. Don't fall in I guess.
